from pathlib import Path
import binascii
for f in Path('.').glob('test_read_format_rar5*.uu'):
    txt=f.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    data=[]
    started=False
    for line in txt:
        if line.startswith('begin '):
            started=True; continue
        if line.startswith('end'): break
        if started and line.strip():
            try:
                data.append(binascii.a2b_uu(line))
            except Exception:
                pass
    out=f.with_suffix('')
    out.write_bytes(b''.join(data))
    print(f.name, out.stat().st_size)
    break
